title: 第3章 神秘地图第4章 青灵山脉
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
从长老阁出来，林白深知，只要林家的长老不松口，那林铎留下来给林白的修炼资源就别想拿回来。
毕竟，以林白心中的武道修为，还不足以和林家的长老阁相争。
“一群混账东西，当年我爹在的时候，他们连屁都不敢放一个，现在却敢霸占我爹留给我的修炼资源！
林白回到家中，怒火冲霄的说着。
“林白。”
整个时候，门外传来一个苍老的声音，林白回头看去，一个佝偻着身子，满脸沧桑的老者，带着笑容的走入了源自中。
林白抬头一看：“三叔，你怎么来了。”
走进来的老者，是林白的三叔林跃，自幼和林白的父亲感情极好。
但在多年前，三叔跟着林铎出去的时候，突然被人废了丹田，至此之后就留在了林家中，没有外出过。
林跃走进来，笑着：“我听说你觉醒的武魂并不好，所以我过来看看，怕你做出什么傻事。”
“谢谢你，三叔，你身子骨不好，还费心过来看我。”林白摇摇头，苦笑着。
林跃笑道：“哈哈，我和你父亲，毕竟还是生死兄弟，他现在不在林家，我不管你，谁管你？”
“林白啊，虽然你的武魂并不好，但是你也不要灰心，林铎大哥不是给你留下了一笔修炼资源嘛，你可要先去取出来，加快自己的修炼速度，我相信以你的天资，纵然是黄级一品的武魂，也能成就一番事业的。”
林跃给林白鼓劲道。
林白听见这笔修炼资源的事情，顿时恼羞成怒的说道：“我就是为这件事情而怒的，我刚刚去长老阁，想要取回我父亲留下的修炼资源，可是长老阁和林紫儿那群混账东西，见我武魂低下，不愿意给我。”
林跃惊讶道：“他们敢私吞林铎大哥的东西，难道就不怕林铎大哥回来，大发雷霆吗？”
林白冷声道：“他们现在看林紫儿比我父亲的天赋高，全部巴结她去了！”
“啊，是这样啊。”林跃面色也有些焦虑道：“他们这么做，真的是太过分了。那林白，你有什么打算吗？”
林白道：“他们以为我武魂低下，又没有拿到修炼资源，我就甘心做一个凡人，等着瞧吧，我已经决定要去青灵山脉猎杀妖兽，换取修炼资源了。”
“林白，你要去青灵山脉呀，那里是妖兽的天堂，你可要千万小心。”林跃关心的提醒道。

林白道：“青灵山脉虽然危险，但却是我最好的历练之地！”
吞噬剑魂可用吞噬妖兽神血来修炼，那么青灵山脉对于林白来说，就是一座不二之选的修炼之地！
林跃浑浊的眼珠子转了一下，从怀中摸出了一张羊皮地图，递给林白说道：“林白，你把这个收下，到了青灵山脉会有用处的。”
“这是什么？”林白接过来，好奇的问道。
林跃笑道：“我当年还没有被废的时候，曾经去青灵山脉过，当时就发现了有一树孕灵果，可惜当时还没有成熟。”
“所以我就将路线画下来，像等以后成熟了，我再去摘。”
“那会想到，我还没有等到孕灵果成熟，我就已经先被人废了。”
林跃苦笑连连的说道。
“孕灵果！”林白听见这个名字，惊喜得双目发直。
孕灵果是用来炼制二品丹药的灵药，需要三十年的开花，三十年的结果，三十年的成熟，可谓是灵药中的极品了。
当然，这孕灵果对于林白现在来说，无比的需要。
林白道：“三叔，这东西太贵重了。”
林跃打哈哈的笑着：“你拿着吧，三叔没有儿女，现在又是一个废人，这个地图留在我这里也没有什么用处，你拿去吧，好好修炼，别给你父亲丢脸。”
content_en:
After coming out of the Elder Pavilion, Lin Bai knew that as long as the elders of the Lin family did not relent, they would never get back the training resources that Lin Duo had left for Lin Bai.
After all, Lin Bai's martial arts cultivation was not enough to compete with the Lin family's Elder Pavilion.
"A bunch of bastards. When my father was here, they didn't even dare to let out a fart, but now they dare to occupy the cultivation resources that my father left for me!
Lin Bai returned home and said angrily.
"Lin Bai. "
At this time, an old voice came from outside the door. Lin Bai looked back and saw an old man with a stooped body and a face full of vicissitudes of life, walking into Yunzhong with a smile.
Lin Bai looked up and said, "Uncle Third, why are you here? "
The old man who walked in was Lin Bai's third uncle, Lin Yue. He had been very close to Lin Bai's father since he was a child.
But many years ago, when the third uncle followed Lin Duo out, his Dantian was suddenly destroyed. Since then, he has stayed in the Lin family and has never gone out.
Lin Yue walked in and smiled: "I heard that your awakened martial spirit was not good, so I came over to take a look, fearing that you would do something stupid. "
"Thank you, Third Uncle, for taking the trouble to come and see me despite your poor health. Lin Bai shook his head and smiled bitterly.
Lin Yue smiled and said: "Haha, your father and I are still brothers in life and death after all. He is not in the Lin family now. I don't care about you, who cares about you? "
"Lin Bai, although your martial spirit is not very good, don't be discouraged. Brother Lin Duo left you a training resource. You must take it out first and speed up your cultivation. I believe that with your talent, even a yellow-level first-grade martial spirit can achieve a great career. "
Lin Yue encouraged Lin Bai.
When Lin Bai heard about the cultivation resources, he immediately became angry and said: "I am angry because of this matter. I just went to the Elder Pavilion to get back the cultivation resources left by my father, but those bastards from the Elder Pavilion and Lin Zier saw that my martial spirit was low and were unwilling to give it to me. "
Lin Yue said in surprise: "They dare to steal Brother Lin Duo's things, aren't they afraid that Brother Lin Duo will come back and get angry? "
Lin Bai said coldly: "They now see that Lin Zi'er is more talented than my father, so they all fawn over her! "
"Ah, that's right. Lin Yue looked a little anxious and said, "What they did is really too much." So Lin Bai, what are your plans? "
Lin Bai said: "They thought that my martial spirit was low and I didn't get the training resources, so I was willing to be a mortal. Just wait and see, I have decided to go to the Qingling Mountains to hunt monsters in exchange for training resources. "
"Lin Bai, you are going to the Qingling Mountains, which is a paradise for monsters, so you must be careful. Lin Yue reminded with concern.
Lin Bai said: "Although the Qingling Mountains are dangerous, they are my best place for training! "
Swallowing sword souls can be practiced by swallowing the divine blood of demonic beasts, so the Qingling Mountains is the perfect training place for Lin Bai!
Lin Yue rolled his turbid eyes, took out a sheepskin map from his arms, handed it to Lin Bai and said, "Lin Bai, take this, it will be useful in the Qingling Mountains. "
"What's this? Lin Bai took it and asked curiously.
Lin Yue said with a smile: "When I was not deposed, I once went to the Qingling Mountains, and I discovered a tree pregnant with spirit fruit, but it was a pity that it was not mature yet. "
“So I drew the route and waited until it was ripe before I picked it. "
"Then I would have thought that before I could wait for the Pregnant Spirit Fruit to mature, I would have been crippled first. "
Lin Yue said with a wry smile.
“Pregnancy Spirit Fruit! "When Lin Bai heard the name, his eyes widened with surprise.
The Pregnant Spirit Fruit is an elixir used to refine second-grade elixirs. It takes thirty years to bloom, thirty years to bear fruit, and thirty years to mature. It can be said to be the best elixir.
Of course, this pregnancy spirit fruit is extremely needed for Lin Bai now.want.
Lin Bai said: "Third uncle, this thing is too valuable."
Lin Yue laughed heartily: "Take it. Third uncle has no children and is now a useless man. This map is of no use if I keep it here. Take it and practice hard and don't embarrass your father."
